ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping home? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping home.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping home.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.

11. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

13. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

14. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

15. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

16. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Exploring weather? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Exploring weather.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Exploring weather.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Exploring weather.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Exploring weather.

18. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.

20. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Energy resources.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Plants its resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

29. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Light environment School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
